# PennyRail

> PennyRail is an agent transaction router: FREE FIND → FREE QUOTE → PAID EXECUTE.

Base URL: https://pennyrail.vercel.app
Remote MCP: https://pennyrail.vercel.app/api/mcp
Agent skill: https://pennyrail.vercel.app/SKILL.md

## Recommended agent workflow

1. Call the remote MCP tool `pennyrail_find` with the natural-language job.
2. Call `pennyrail_quote` for the selected `productId`.
3. Pay/call only the returned x402 `executeUrl`.

Direct HTTP:
- POST /api/router/find — free
- POST /api/router/quote — free
- paid execution — exact URL returned by quote

Payments:
- protocol: x402
- network: Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`)
- currency: USDC

PennyRail should be treated as one universal transaction router, not as hundreds of unrelated APIs.
